parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true: 'iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession' in Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift and 'MetadataMockWebSession' in Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/PlaycutMetadataServiceCachingTests.swift. Although they share the field 'requestedURLs:[URL]' and a structurally similar 'responses' field, the differing slot ('responses:[Data]' vs 'responses:[String: Data]') reflects genuinely different test-fixture contracts for their respective services. Extracting a generic shared mock into production-visible shared infrastructure would couple two independent test packages and risk obscuring the distinct response-lookup semantics each fixture intentionally encodes.
